g.text: rule (token_supported). The pooled 5.4% mixes strata sampled at fixed sizes, so it is not a population estimate. The extractor paraphrased text, so the strict rate understates

g.text: support. Intervals treat sentences as independent; they cluster within pages, so true uncertainty is wider.
